title: Mississippi's 2nd Congressional District election, 2026
description: This race will determine the U.S. Representative for Mississippi's 2nd Congressional District, a predominantly rural and African American-majority district spanning the Mississippi Delta, including most of Jackson, Greenville, Natchez, and Vicksburg. Incumbent Democrat Bennie Thompson, first elected in 1993 and ranking member of the House Homeland Security Committee, faces Republican nominee Ron Eller, a physician assistant and retired Army captain whom Thompson defeated 62%-38% in 2024, and Independent candidate Bennie Foster, an educator and community organizer. The primary elections were held March 10, 2026, with Thompson winning the Democratic primary with 86.4% and Eller narrowly defeating Kevin Wilson with about 51% in the Republican primary. The district has a Cook Partisan Voting Index of D+11 and is rated "Solid D" by the Cook Political Report, though Eller's third consecutive challenge signals continued Republican investment.
polling_note: No public opinion polls were found for the 2026 general election in Mississippi's 2nd Congressional District. The Cook Political Report rates this race as 'Solid D' based on the district's D+11 Partisan Voting Index.

candidates.name: Bennie Thompson
candidates.summary: Bennie Thompson is the incumbent U.S. Representative for Mississippi's 2nd Congressional District, first elected in a special election in 1993. He serves as Ranking Member of the House Committee on Homeland Security and previously chaired the Select Committee to Investigate the January 6th Attack on the U.S. Capitol. Thompson, a veteran of the civil rights movement who worked as a field organizer for Fannie Lou Hamer's 1964 congressional campaign, focuses on civil rights, healthcare access, HBCU funding, and rural development.

candidates.name: Ron Eller
candidates.summary: Ron Eller is the Republican nominee for Mississippi's 2nd Congressional District, making his third consecutive bid for the seat. He is a cardiothoracic physician assistant at St. Dominic Hospital in Jackson and a retired U.S. Army Captain who served 20 years on active duty. Eller also owns manufacturing businesses and previously served as director at large of the Mississippi Academy of Physician Assistants.

candidates.name: Bennie Foster
candidates.summary: Bennie Foster is an Independent candidate running for Mississippi's 2nd Congressional District. He is a lifelong Jackson native with a Master's Degree in Education and over 38 years of experience in education administration, mentorship, and community development. Foster leads the 'ReIMAGINE Mississippi' campaign, traveling through all 28 counties of the district to deliver resources and advocate for economic empowerment, infrastructure investment, and government transparency.
